Epoch reward calculation and distribution for stake and vote accounts.

# Purpose
This file implements partitioned epoch reward calculation and distribution for the bank runtime. It computes inflation rates, determines the reward period, and calculates validator rewards from the previous epoch. It also computes stake and vote rewards for each stake delegation and vote account, applies commission split rules, and updates reward-related state in the bank and sysvars. The code uses bank feature flags, epoch schedule data, stake history, and vote state data to match the reward rules used by the Solana stake program and runtime.

The file also manages reward partitioning and payout. It creates the `fd_epoch_rewards_t` state for an epoch, hashes stake rewards into partitions, and distributes those partitions across blocks. During distribution, it updates stake accounts, vote accounts, capitalization, and the `epoch rewards` sysvar, and it writes capture events when capture is enabled. It also includes a recalculation path for cases where the node must rebuild partitioned rewards during startup or replay, using previous vote credits and the frontier stake delegation set.
